# Labs Mnemostroma

> Live AI automation you can run before you buy

Labs Mnemostroma is a showcase of working AI pipelines for document processing, request handling, and CRM integration. Run demos on your own data, inspect every source and confidence score, and keep a human signature before anything leaves the system.

## What We Do

- **Document Processing (OCR/Extraction)** — AI-powered document understanding with confidence scoring
- **RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)** — Semantic search over your documents with cited answers
- **PDF Report Generation** — Automated report assembly from structured data
- **Dispatcher** — Intelligent request routing and classification
- **CRM Integration** — AI-assisted customer relationship management
- **Analyst** — Data analysis and insights pipeline
- **Agent Mesh** — Multi-agent orchestration platform

## Demos

Interactive demos are available at `/demos/{slug}`:
- `/demos/dispatcher` — Request routing and classification
- `/demos/extraction` — Document OCR and data extraction
- `/demos/rag` — Retrieval-augmented generation
- `/demos/reports` — PDF report generation
- `/demos/crm` — CRM integration
- `/demos/analyst` — Data analysis

Demo status: `GET /api/v1/demos`

## API

Base URL: `https://labs.mnemostroma.com/api/v1`

### Endpoints

| Method | Path | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| POST | `/consult` | Submit consultation request |
| GET | `/consult/{ref}` | Check consultation status |
| GET | `/slots` | List available booking slots |
| GET | `/demos` | Get demo statuses |
| POST | `/demos/{slug}/wake` | Wake a sleeping demo |
| GET | `/health` | Health check |

### Authentication

- Public endpoints: no auth required
- Rate limiting: IP-based, varies per endpoint
- CAPTCHA: Cloudflare Turnstile on consultation form

## Languages

- English (default): `/`
- Ukrainian: `/uk/`
- Polish: `/pl/`
- Russian: `/ru/`

## Contact

- Website: https://labs.mnemostroma.com
- Consultation: POST `/api/v1/consult`
- Location: Ukraine / EU / remote
